text: Irakli Kobakhidze - Just as the Prime Minister, the State Minister will be served by the full resources of the Government Administration; there is nothing to mock here, though the opposition manages to speculate even on this – this is their true face and it is not interesting (28.04.2026, 16:17)

"Just like the Prime Minister, the Vice Prime Minister and the State Minister for Coordination of Law Enforcement Agencies will be fully served by the resources of the Government Administration—as you can see, there is nothing to mock here, yet the opposition still manages to spread speculations; this is their true nature and it is not interesting," Prime Minister Irakli Kobakhidze told journalists.
According to him, the purpose of creating the new structural unit is to further strengthen the law enforcement system.

“These changes served to further strengthen the law enforcement system. A new link has emerged—a coordination unit. Mamuka Mdinaradze was performing this function even before, but from a specific agency. This was the factual situation. We decided to formalize the existing reality, which is the right move and was already established. In reality, there will be independent structures. Naturally, these are the Ministry of Internal Affairs, the State Security Service, and the Special State Protection Service, and [the new role] will ensure their overall coordination. The new position of State Minister is intended for this purpose, which will further strengthen the fight against crime and the efforts to maintain public order. As you know, over the past year, we have seen fundamental changes in all directions,” Kobakhidze stated.

Furthermore, the Prime Minister responded to a question regarding parallels between the former head of the State Security Service, Grigol Liluashvili, who is in custody, and Mamuka Mdinaradze, noting that "then the processes proceeded differently, now they will proceed differently."

"The situation is radically different. The context is completely different. Mamuka Mdinaradze is an exceptionally successful member of our team. Specifically, his activities in the State Security Service were exceptionally successful, including in the areas of corruption and terrorist crimes. He implemented very important systemic changes. This is a different background; therefore, against a different background, future development will also be different," stated Kobakhidze.

Parliament is considering a draft law through an expedited procedure, which provides for the introduction of the position of State Minister for the Coordination of Law Enforcement Agencies within the Government of Georgia. According to the bill, the Government Administration will provide material-technical and organizational support for the activities of the new State Minister.

According to Vakhtang Bachiashvili, the Parliamentary Secretary of the Government, the powers of the State Minister will be specified in a government decree. He also stated that the State Minister for the Coordination of Law Enforcement Agencies will be located in the Government Administration building.
